snippet.description:
🌳 Coming August 12: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164310/Verde/
Build a small town of seedlets, mysterious seed like creatures in this cozy city builder. Build facilities, put up decorations and help the seedlets thrive!

Assemble Entertainment is an independent publisher based in Germany, best known for indie hits such as Sticky Business, Roadwarden, Decktamer, Paddle Paddle Paddle, Asgard's Fall and the Endzone franchise. Since 2016, Assemble has released more than 50 games across different genres, including cozy, horror, strategy and roguelike, and has established itself as a trusted partner for bringing original indie projects to market. #assembleentertainment
